name: button-group
title: ButtonGroup
purpose: Present a connected set of mutually exclusive actions with one selected item.

composition.selection: Exactly one option id is represented by modelValue and aria-pressed. An omitted variant resolves from surface to glass under the nearest Glassmorphism theme. The default rounded shape resolves to rounded-none in Brutalism. In the neutral surface, outline, and glass variants, color emphasizes the selected option only and unselected options stay muted-neutral until hover; the solid variant tints every option.
composition.codeSurface: The code variant provides the compact code-foreground treatment used by CodeBlock header actions, with a compact control radius in every design theme.

accessibility: Expose the selected option with aria-pressed.
Retain accessible button names when collapseLabels hides visible labels.
commonMistakes: Reaching through the group with nested important selectors instead of using its typed code variant.
Expecting color to tint unselected options in the neutral surface, outline, and glass variants.

examples.title: Solid
examples.description: Use a solid group for the primary mode switch in a local workbench.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import ButtonGroup from "@/components/ui/ButtonGroup.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Code2, Eye } from "@lucide/vue";

const activeView = ref("preview");
const viewOptions = [
  { id: "preview", label: "Option 01", icon: Eye },
  { id: "code", label: "Option 02", icon: Code2 },
];
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonGroup v-model="activeView" :options="viewOptions" label="Options placeholder" size="md" variant="solid" />
</template>
